slides.headlineRest: Linked to Indian IT Provider Breach
slides.body: The North Korean threat actor known as Jade Sleet has been attributed to the compromise of an India-based IT services provider. This incident, disclosed by cybersecurity company SentinelOne, highlights the adversary's ongoing strategy to target developers to breach networks. The activity reportedly involved the use of Apple technologies in the attack. This emphasizes the critical need for robust security measures within the IT services industry, especially for smaller organizations.
